# Pegasustec

> Independent software and infrastructure engineering, built on Elixir. Simple, reliable, and made to scale.

Pegasustec is the independent, B2B consultancy of Cristiano Carvalho, based in Ponta Grossa, Paraná, Brazil (UTC−03:00). He has 9+ years in backend engineering and 8+ years building Elixir/OTP systems, including freight payments of $2B+ on event-sourced systems. Elixir is the main stack; Ruby and Python are also taken on. Work in stacks he cannot review well is declined, because AI-written code is only as good as the person checking it.

## Services

- [Software development](https://pegasustec.dev/#services): web applications and backend systems in Elixir, interfaces in Phoenix LiveView, architecture reviews and audits of existing codebases.
- [Financial & event-driven systems](https://pegasustec.dev/#services): payment flows, ledgers and workflows modeled as events, so every change is auditable and can be replayed (event sourcing, CQRS, payments).
- [Cloud & infrastructure](https://pegasustec.dev/#services): secure, observable and cost-aware infrastructure (Terraform, Docker, Google Cloud).

## How the work is done

- [Approach](https://pegasustec.dev/#approach): simple, reliable, transparent, built to last, and asynchronous by default: work can be done from anywhere, and hours are flexible for live calls.
- [How AI is used](https://pegasustec.dev/#ai): agents write much of the code and the human owns every line that ships. Plan, build, verify, human review, automated gate, ship, learn.
